author: Syrian Observatory for Human Rights

content_variants.text:
Anti-ISIS raid campaign | SDF and Coalition forces kill man and blow up his house, east of Deir Ezzor

In the early hours of Monday morning, SDF forces, backed by International Coalition forces and helicopters, have carried out a raid campaign, targeting a house of a suspected ISIS man in Al-Litwah neighbourhood in Dhiban city in the eastern countryside of Deir Ezzor, SOHR sources reported.

According to Syrian Observatory sources, the wanted man has refused to surrender, thus SDF and the International Coalition forces killed him and blew up his house.

On March 12, Reliable sources informed SOHR that Al-Hawl camp in Al-Hasakah countryside, which hosts families of ISIS members and leaders, were witnessing an alert of SDF security forces and SDF security forces carried out raids on some tents in search of ISIS cells and weapons.

This security campaign coincided with the flight by international coalition helicopters over the camp.
